decks.notes: The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a steady stream of aggressive creatures to pressure them. By utilizing cards like Spyglass Siren and Preacher of the Schism to control the board, as well as spells like Go for the Throat for removal, this deck aims to establish a dominant position early in the game. Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide powerful finishers to close out the game quickly. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth access to both blue and black mana sources.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing the Omniscience Combo to quickly gain advantage over opponents. By casting spells for free with Omniscience in play, the deck aims to control the board with card draw, counterspells, and removal spells like Confounding Riddle and Ephara's Dispersal. The deck includes tools like Chart a Course and Meticulous Archive to find key pieces of the combo while also managing resources. Additionally, cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Invasion of Arcavios provide alternate win conditions. Overall, the deck focuses on assembling the combo and overwhelming opponents with powerful plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal significant damage. It includes a mix of powerful creatures such as Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Preacher of the Schism, as well as removal spells like Go for the Throat and Destroy Evil to control the board. The deck also has card draw options like Stock Up and Stormchaser's Talent to maintain momentum. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of colored sources to ensure smooth gameplay.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of board wipes, creature removal spells, and card draw effects. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up your own resources. Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Zur, Eternal Schemer provide strong control elements, while cards like Analyze the Pollen and Leyline Binding help to keep the opponent's threats in check. The deck also includes lands that provide additional utility, such as Cavern of Souls and Floodfarm Verge. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's plans and resources. By using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's progress while generating card advantage. The deck also includes cards that can provide card draw and generate value over time. Additionally, the deck includes a win condition in the form of creature threats that can overwhelm the opponent if left unchecked. Overall, the deck focuses on outlasting the opponent and securing victory through careful resource management.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful burn spells. By playing efficient creatures like Manifold Mouse and Monastery Swiftspear, and using burn spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. Cards like Rockface Village and Soulstone Sanctuary help to support the aggressive game plan by providing additional mana and card advantage. Overall, the deck is designed to apply constant pressure and end the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a combination of low-cost creatures and direct damage spells. It aims to maintain a strong board presence through aggressive creature plays while also being able to finish off opponents with burn spells. The inclusion of cards like Monstrous Rage and Emberheart Challenger enhance the deck's ability to deal damage efficiently and effectively. The strategy involves applying constant pressure to opponents and forcing them to react defensively, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control cards to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy while slowly gaining advantage through card advantage and resource denial. By combining cards like Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown with creatures like Overlord of the Hauntwoods and Overlord of the Mistmoors, the deck aims to lock down the opponent's options and slowly grinding out a victory. With access to powerful spells like Ride's End and Zur, Eternal Schemer, the deck can adapt to different situations and outmaneuver opponents.

The deck focuses on utilizing a mix of aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. Cards like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Hopeless Nightmare put pressure on the opponent, while removal spells like Go for the Throat and Destroy Evil help clear the way for attacks. Stock Up and This Town Ain't Big Enough provide card advantage and board control. The deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately leading to a quick victory through aggression and efficiency.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards that control the game by limiting your opponent's options and resources. By playing cards such as Leyline Binding, Temporary Lockdown, and Ride's End, you can prevent your opponent from building up their board or executing their game plan effectively. Additionally, the deck includes powerful creatures like Zur, Eternal Schemer and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to apply pressure on your opponent while maintaining control of the game. The combination of control elements and strong creatures allows you to dictate the pace of the game and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off to apply early pressure on the opponent. Cards like Monstrous Rage and Might of the Meek help pump up these creatures for extra damage. Leyline of Resonance and Turn Inside Out provide additional ways to boost the power of your creatures. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and efficient combat tricks, aiming to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Mosswood Dreadknight and Preacher of the Schism, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain board control. The inclusion of Llanowar Elves and Sentinel of the Nameless City allows for ramping up mana and playing threats ahead of schedule. With efficient removal spells like Go for the Throat and Wastewood Verge, the deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's strategy while pushing for a fast victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to manage the opponent's board and resources efficiently. It includes cards like Split Up, Caretaker's Talent, and Get Lost to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also features powerful creatures like Archangel Elspeth and Beza, the Bounding Spring to establish board presence. The deck also includes removal spells like Carrot Cake and Lay Down Arms to deal with threats. The mana base consists mainly of Plains, Sunken Citadel, and Fountainport to ensure consistent casting of spells. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent through control tactics and powerful creatures.

This UW Control deck focuses on stalling the game with counterspells and board wipes, using cards like Day of Judgment and Negate to control the opponent's threats. Jace, the Perfected Mind provides card advantage while Get Lost and Ride's End remove key cards from the opponent's hand and battlefield. The deck also includes bounce effects like Overlord of the Mistmoors and Tishana's Tidebinder to deal with problematic permanents. The mana base is carefully designed to ensure smooth color access and consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on being aggressive and controlling the board with spells like Pyroclasm and Spell Pierce while also utilizing disruptive cards like Recommission and This Town Ain't Big Enough. The key strategy is to quickly build up a board presence with creatures like Steamcore Scholar and Fear of Missing Out, while also utilizing cards like Proft's Eidetic Memory to draw more resources. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and spells to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on overwhelming your opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells in order to quickly deplete their life total. It utilizes a combination of low-cost creatures like Heartfire Hero and Emberheart Challenger, alongside efficient burn spells like Burst Lightning and Boros Charm. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent, using cards like Monstrous Rage and Cheeky House-Mouse to maximize damage output. Overall, Boros Aggro aims to win the game swiftly through a combination of creature aggression and burn spells.
